title: Log in with email and password and reach the dashboard
description: An existing user signs in with valid credentials and lands on the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the dashboard is displayed

title: Create a gig and see it in the gig list
description: A signed-in admin creates a new gig with event details and a total fee, saves it, and the gig appears in the gig list with a status badge.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /gigs
Start creating a new gig
Fill in the event name with a unique name such as TestSprite Verify Gig, and fill in the client, venue, city, event date, gig type, and total fee
Save the gig
Verify the gig list shows a gig row with the exact event name that was entered, with a status badge next to it

title: Review a gig settlement and change its status
description: A signed-in admin opens a gig detail, sees the settlement breakdown, changes the gig status, and the updated status is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /gigs
Open a gig detail from the gig list
Verify the settlement breakdown section is displayed
Change the gig status to a different status
Verify the updated gig status is displayed

title: View current members and crew lists in masters
description: A signed-in admin opens the masters page and sees the members list and the crew list populated.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /masters
Verify the members list is displayed with member rows
Verify the crew list is displayed with crew rows
